comments.author: Raythe
comments.body:
You will pay a premium price when dealing with Servicio, but I have yet to hear of anyone not getting what they paid for. Before he/she came along scamming was rampant. 100's of millions would change hands only for the buyer to come up empty-handed.

If you don't like Servicio's system it is very easy to break. Make your own buyer/seller, set them in Seville and undercut prices until you force everybody else out of business or bring all prices down to your level.

Otherwise I'd suggest you quit griping.

And I feel strongly enough about it to put my real IGN up there too.

Do I think prices are too high? Yeah really I do, but until more people offer the same services for lower pricing there is absolutely no point in griping about it on a 3rd party website.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Well, we might someday see this recipe book available for sale on GAMA via the Astro Shop (it was part of a virtual pack for Japanese players). It would probably be reasonably pricey to offset the ease with which any players who owned the book could then produce the items from it. And perhaps with OGP selling certain ship parts in the Astro Shop, which I have no problem with BTW, maybe it won't be released, either.

However, I can't sadly picture the Special Sewing Designs for Celebs book ever being released for GAMA. The reason is, the outfits it yields have only been released in the past as TB/bottle/Astro Shop promotions; which would profit KOEI-TECMO and OGP while helping support the game monetarily more efficiently: selling a few recipe books that make virtually endless outfits players want, or releasing the outfits in the Astro Shop or bottles to encourage players' spending?

It's unfortunate to say the least, but as the Celebs book was only available to Asian players through virtual packs, on top of the subscription fees they have to pay just to play UWO... well, GAMA players still managed to come out ahead a bit, since the Celebs outfits aren't completely unobtainable.
